name: humanizer-plugin
description: Codex plugin with Editorial Humanizer and Faithful Humanizer.

interface.longDescription: Two clearly separated Codex writing editors: Editorial Humanizer applies broader anti-slop judgment and may reshape or remove weak material, while Faithful Humanizer changes only presentation and preserves every supplied claim, qualifier, attribution, example, and logical relation.
defaultPrompt: Use $editorial-humanizer to improve this draft with broader editorial judgment:
Use $faithful-humanizer to improve the wording without changing the substance:
Use $editorial-humanizer to audit and score this draft for AI-writing patterns.
